profile: Software engineering leader combining hands-on architecture, people development and cross-team delivery in regulated financial services. Leads 2 squads and 15+ engineers across 20+ systems/services. Connects Java/JVM, AWS, distributed systems, data, AI, product and security with reliable production delivery. Career initiatives include R$800M+ in reported revenue and fraud-loss mitigation outcomes.
author_line: Technical author of 13 published articles on AI, Java, data and distributed systems, translating complex engineering into clear, practical learning.

roles.title: Lead Software Engineer
bullets: Own technical direction for 2 squads and 15+ engineers across 20+ fraud engines, systems and services supporting Pix, debit and credit cards, vehicle and mortgage credit, and crypto journeys.
Drive hands-on modernization of a ~1,900-file legacy landscape into maintainable AWS services and repositories, using Java, Spring Boot, Kotlin, Python, REST APIs, Kafka, Redis and IBM MQ.

Define architecture and engineering standards across distributed systems, Terraform, Kubernetes, Docker, CI/CD, DevSecOps, automated testing, observability and SRE; guide design reviews and production reliability.

Shape technical roadmaps across Engineering, Product, Architecture, Data, Security, Risk and Business; build AI agents and engineering automation with RAG, MCP, LangGraph, Claude Code, Devin and GitHub Copilot.

roles.title: Lead Software Engineer
roles.context: Credit Platforms & Digital Channels | Osasco, Brazil
bullets: Led architecture and launch of an investment-backed personal-credit platform associated with R$150M+ in new revenue, directing 3 cross-functional squads and integrating Java microservices, Kafka, HBase, Python and FICO eligibility rules.
Led secured-lending initiatives covering CCB issuance, collateral locks, credit and investment rules, and alphanumeric CNPJ modernization across hybrid cloud and mainframe systems.
Designed and evolved enterprise credit services with Saga and circuit-breaker patterns; modernized COBOL, JCL and DB2 integrations alongside Java services and Azure environments.

Led backend, BFF and mobile delivery across TypeScript, Kotlin, Swift, Java, REST APIs and Redis; strengthened CI/CD, DevSecOps, observability and production stability, and contributed to the Bitbucket-to-GitHub migration.

Mentored junior through senior engineers through design reviews, solution assessments, pull-request reviews, feedback and career development; aligned Product, Security, Architecture, Infrastructure, Operations and Business.

roles.title: Senior Java Software Engineer
bullets: Engineered backend services and integrations for vehicle, consortium and mortgage credit using Java, Spring Boot, Spring MVC, Spring Data, Hibernate/JPA, JDBC and SQL.

Connected FICO Credit Engine business rules with Python/PySpark analysis and systems of record / sources of truth (SoR/SoT); translated credit requirements into secure, traceable APIs and maintainable workflows.
Supported architecture evolution, production incidents, automated testing, CI/CD and observability with a focus on reliability, performance, authentication and authorization.

roles.title: Senior Technical Product Manager
bullets: Led squads across product, engineering, data, cybersecurity and risk; owned discovery, roadmaps, backlog priorities, stakeholder alignment and delivery of customer-protection solutions.

Turned ambiguous fraud scenarios into APIs, integrations, data flows, security requirements and measurable initiatives; built engineering capability across backend and frontend while balancing risk, customer experience and operational efficiency.

roles.title: Product Manager
bullets: Evolved fraud-prevention products, internal tools and digital journeys through business analysis, process mapping, data interpretation, requirements, prioritization, solution validation and outcome monitoring.
Connected Engineering, Analytics, Operations, Security and Business on fraud rules, customer journeys, integrations and risk-based product improvements.

roles.title: Fraud Prevention Junior Analyst
bullets: Delivered R$300M in reported fraud-loss savings through an automated AWS SageMaker machine-learning pipeline integrated with legacy TCP/IP systems.

Led the WhatsApp fraud-alert initiative later recognized with the Walther Moreira Salles award; analyzed suspicious behavior, indicators, controls and operational processes to improve customer protection.

roles.title: Corporate Security Intern
bullets: Supported security, operational controls, risk awareness, governance, documentation and internal procedures, building a foundation in banking risk and business continuity.

roles.title: Investments Intern
bullets: Supported FIDC investment structures, personal-credit operations, documentation and commercial processes, with responsibility for operations on a R$100M+ portfolio.

career_note: Career progression: investment operations, security and fraud analytics, followed by product leadership, software engineering and technical leadership.

tech.title: Product, leadership & communication

tech.title: Architecture & integration
tech.body: Microservices, distributed systems, event-driven architecture, BFF, Saga, Circuit Breaker, GoF design patterns, Lambda/Kappa architectures, SoR/SoT integration, FICO Credit Engine, mainframe modernization and hybrid cloud.

tech.title: Languages & programming
tech.body: Java, Kotlin, Python, TypeScript, JavaScript, SQL; Go, Swift, C#, .NET, COBOL, JCL. Additional profile breadth: C, PHP, VBA, LINQ, object-oriented and functional programming, Streams, lambdas and reflection.

tech.title: Backend & APIs
tech.body: Spring Boot, Spring MVC, Spring Data, Spring Security, Hibernate, JPA, JDBC, DAO, Lombok, Java Servlet, Maven, Node.js, Express.js, Django, Django REST Framework; REST, OpenAPI/Swagger, GraphQL and gRPC.

tech.title: Cloud infrastructure & delivery
tech.body: AWS, Microsoft Azure, Terraform, Docker, Kubernetes, Linux, virtualization and CI/CD. Further applied study: Google Cloud, GKE, Ansible, Helm, Istio, ArgoCD, Azure Red Hat OpenShift and Amazon Lightsail.

tech.title: DevSecOps, SRE & quality
tech.body: Git, GitHub, GitFlow, Bitbucket, Jenkins, SonarQube, Fortify, Veracode, OWASP, JWT, LDAP, authentication and authorization; Datadog, Prometheus, Grafana, Splunk, ELK, SLOs, incident management, JUnit, Cucumber BDD, TDD, Jasmine and Karma.

articles.title: LangChain + LangGraph para entender o DNA: quando o código da vida encontra agentes de IA
articles.summary: Builds a Python and LangGraph workflow that validates DNA, calculates sequence metrics and uses an LLM to explain the results. Connects deterministic computation, state and conditional routing through a practical example, with a linked GitHub implementation.

articles.title: RAG vs. CAG: como dar à IA as informações certas
articles.summary: Explains retrieval, reference context and cache reuse through Python examples. Compares when RAG, CAG or a hybrid approach makes sense, including freshness, token budgets, reuse and answer verification. Shows how to reason about AI architecture beyond framework names.

articles.title: Javeiro pode criar agentes de IA? MCP, LLMs, LangChain, LangChain4j e métricas para criar agentes performáticos com Java
articles.summary: Connects Java engineering with LLMs, LangChain4j, RAG, tool calling and MCP. Covers permissions, validation, observability and evaluation, including latency, cost and task success. Provides a structured path from a simple assistant to a measurable, controlled agent architecture.

articles.title: Como um computador consegue “entender” sentimentos? A engenharia por trás da NLP
articles.summary: Explains how sentiment analysis turns language into numerical representations, from tokenization and embeddings to transformers and attention. Discusses context, classification metrics and bias, combining mathematical intuition with accessible examples and a clear distinction between pattern recognition and human emotion.

articles.title: Redes Neurais? Usando seus próprios neurônios para aprender
articles.summary: Guides readers through a supervised-learning example with Keras and the MNIST dataset. Explains data preparation, network layers, optimization, loss, training and evaluation, using an accessible factory analogy to build intuition before introducing deeper neural-network concepts.
articles.tags: Neural networks · Keras · Python · Machine learning

articles.title: DB2 ou NoSQL: entre a vanguarda e o moderno, qual caminho seguir?
articles.summary: Makes DB2 and NoSQL approachable through concrete analogies and SQL/JSON examples. Discusses transaction integrity, data flexibility and hybrid integration, connecting mainframe knowledge with modern application design and the practical reasoning behind database choices.

articles.title: Demux: uma porta para milhares.
articles.summary: Explores a Java demultiplexer behind AWS load balancers to route legacy TCP traffic into modern services. Covers framing, backpressure, tracing and resilience, connecting protocol handling with incremental modernization and clearer service boundaries.

articles.title: Java threads: evoluindo um programa para ser multitask.
articles.summary: Introduces Java concurrency through Thread, Runnable, lambda expressions, ExecutorService and Spring @Async. Uses service and ticket-sales analogies to explain responsiveness and concurrent execution, while discussing resource limits, synchronization and practical implementation choices.

articles.title: Kubernetes para Iniciantes: Entenda do Zero e Descomplique o Orquestrador de Containers
articles.summary: Explains the problems container orchestration solves and introduces Pods, ReplicaSets, Deployments, Services, configuration and storage. Includes a YAML deployment example and local practice with Minikube, turning infrastructure terminology into a clear path for getting started.

articles.title: Segurança na Internet Descomplicada: Entendendo TLS, SSL, IPSec e DNSSEC
articles.summary: Uses everyday analogies to explain TLS, SSL, IPSec and DNSSEC and the different layers they protect. Connects encrypted application traffic, network tunnels and signed DNS responses, making security concepts approachable for readers beyond specialist engineering teams.

articles.title: TCP, HTTP, DNS? O frio chegou e, com isso, uma sopinha de letrinhas cai bem.
articles.summary: Follows a browser request through DNS resolution, IP routing, NAT and HTTP communication. Explains OSI and TCP/IP layers and introduces practical diagnostics with tools such as dig, traceroute, Wireshark and tcpdump, connecting theory to troubleshooting.

articles.title: Feature Toggle: a troca de figurinhas da TI
articles.summary: Uses a football sticker-album analogy to explain feature flags, gradual rollout and the separation of deployment from release. Covers experimentation, operational switches, permissions, testing and flag governance, translating delivery practices into product and business decisions.
articles.tags: Feature flags · CI/CD · Release strategy · Testing

articles.title: A arte de observar: o que a Copa do Mundo de Clubes ensina sobre monitoramento de sistemas
articles.summary: Builds an instrumented Spring Boot application with Micrometer, Prometheus and Grafana. Uses football analysis to explain logs, metrics and traces, then connects endpoint measurements and dashboards to practical investigation of system health and performance.

article_groups.title: AI engineering & agents
article_groups.intro: Author of 13 technical articles connecting AI, software architecture, Java, data, cloud and security. Combines original analogies, annotated code and practical walkthroughs to make complex ideas accessible. This public body of work demonstrates technical breadth, clear communication and the ability to share engineering knowledge beyond the immediate team.

article_groups.title: Models, language & data
article_groups.intro: From numerical representations to storage decisions, these articles develop intuition before introducing implementation details. The writing connects foundational concepts with practical engineering choices.

article_groups.title: Architecture & execution
article_groups.intro: A recurring thread in the writing is the link between an architectural idea and how software actually runs. Concrete examples connect legacy integration, Java execution and container orchestration.

article_groups.title: Networks & security
article_groups.intro: Clear explanations of network behavior and security boundaries support better engineering discussions across software, infrastructure and security teams.

article_groups.title: Delivery & observability
article_groups.intro: These articles connect delivery decisions with the evidence needed to operate software. Practical examples make rollout strategy, instrumentation and troubleshooting easier to communicate.

education.title: The science of mind and decision making Specialization
education.summary: Cognitive psychology and neuropsychology, covering neuroimaging and empirical research methods; cognitive architecture and the interaction of genetic and experiential factors; psycholinguistics, language acquisition and shared attention; working memory, mental modularity and cross-modal sensory processing; and the neural foundations of executive function, attention, consciousness and free will.

education.title: Object Oriented Programming in Java Specialization
education.summary: Six-month program developed by Duke University and UC San Diego covering Java and object-oriented programming, complex data structures, algorithmic optimization and design patterns. Data-driven projects emphasize computational efficiency, problem solving and the design of scalable, high-performance applications.

education.title: Postgraduate Degree, Computer Software Engineering
education.summary:
Postgraduate Program in Software Engineering at PUC Minas, with a comprehensive focus on software architecture, backend and frontend development, mobile application architecture, APIs and Web Services, DevOps practices, data engineering, software design, requirements engineering, systematic software testing, and software quality.

The program also covers Agile Project Management, software metrics and estimation, user experience design, implementation and continuous evolution of software, digital transformation, and strategic approaches to software design, providing a strong foundation for designing, developing, testing, and managing scalable, high-quality software solutions.

education.title: English Course, English
education.summary: Ongoing English development with daily study throughout the week and a structured focus on one subject per day. Continuous practice in grammar, vocabulary, listening, speaking, reading and communication for professional and international environments.

education.title: Machine Learning Specialization
education.summary: Practical machine learning case studies: house-price prediction, sentiment analysis of user reviews, document retrieval, product recommendations and image search. Hands-on application of ML methods across domains.

education.title: Large Language Models - LLMs Specialization
education.summary: Advanced LLM and generative AI coursework covering transformer architectures, prompt engineering, NLP, applications, responsible AI and model limitations. Focuses on designing, evaluating and integrating LLM-powered solutions into software engineering, product development, automation and digital transformation.

education.title: Bachelor's degree, Business Administration and Management, General
education.summary:
Bachelor’s Degree in Business Administration at UNIP (Universidade Paulista), providing a comprehensive foundation in business management, organizational strategy, finance, marketing, operations, human resources, economics, accounting, entrepreneurship, and project management.

The program developed strong analytical, strategic, and leadership skills, with an emphasis on business decision-making, organizational management, process optimization, and the relationship between technology, business, and digital transformation.

This academic background supports a multidisciplinary approach to technology and product leadership, combining business strategy and management principles with software engineering, technology, and innovation.

education.title: English Grammar Specialization
education.summary: Grammar, sentence structure, vocabulary, comprehension and practical academic and professional communication, strengthening fluency, accuracy and confidence in English.

education.title: English for Science, Technology, Engineering, and Mathematics Specialization
education.summary: English for STEM: scientific and technical vocabulary, reading and listening comprehension, grammar, interpretation of data and scientific methods, and clear communication of complex technical concepts. Supports collaboration with global engineering teams, use of English-language documentation and research, and precise communication in professional and academic environments.

education.institution: Università degli Studi di Napoli Federico II
education.title: English Intermediate B1 Specialization
education.summary: Intermediate English development for professional, academic, business and everyday settings. Covers grammar, vocabulary, listening, speaking, writing, oral expression and interpersonal communication, applied to meetings, presentations, negotiations, interviews, professional correspondence and workplace interaction. Develops clear messages and confident collaboration in international and multicultural environments.

education.title: Advanced Academic Speaking and Listening Specialization
education.summary: Advanced academic and professional listening and speaking, including note-taking, discussions, public speaking, presentation delivery, critical thinking and verbal and non-verbal communication. Practical activities develop comprehension of complex lectures and conversations, clear organization of ideas and confident expression. Includes a final academic presentation project.

education.title: Cyber Security – Technology and Governance Specialization
education.summary: Computer and network security from hardware to applications, including core components and system operation. Examines human factors in cybercrime, social engineering, criminals, victims and law enforcement. Covers practical security management and governance, incident response and the role of people in improving organizational security outcomes.

education.title: Data Mining Specialization
education.summary: The Data Mining Specialization teaches data mining techniques for both structured data which conform to a clearly defined schema, and unstructured data which exist in the form of natural language text. Specific course topics include pattern discovery, clustering, text retrieval, text mining and analytics, and data visualization.

education.title: Algebra: Elementary to Advanced Specialization
education.summary: Algebra and geometry foundations for precalculus and calculus, with quantitative reasoning, logical thinking and informed use of data. A sequence of applied problems and worked solutions develops practical mathematical fluency, with progressively challenging exercises throughout the modules. Covers equations and inequalities, functions and their applications, domains and ranges, exponential functions, polynomials and roots.

education.title: Algorithms Specialization
education.summary: Algorithm design, mathematical analysis and low-level implementation. Covers divide and conquer, sorting, searching, randomized algorithms, Big-O analysis, inversion counting, matrix multiplication, the master method and randomized quicksort. Graph topics include BFS, DFS, topological sort, Dijkstra, Bellman-Ford and Floyd-Warshall. Data structures include heaps, balanced search trees and hash tables. Also covers greedy algorithms, minimum spanning trees, Prim, Kruskal, Huffman codes, dynamic programming and NP-completeness.

education.title: Large Language Model Operations (LLMOps) Specialization
education.summary: Large Language Model engineering, deployment, operation, lifecycle management, scaling and optimization in production. Covers generative AI, open-source and locally hosted LLMs, model serving and monitoring, LLMOps/MLOps, application architecture, and AI infrastructure across AWS, Azure, Databricks and local environments. Hands-on projects connect software engineering, cloud, DevOps and data engineering with reliable, scalable generative AI systems and practical deployment challenges.

education.title: Machine Learning and Reinforcement Learning in Finance Specialization
education.summary: Machine learning and reinforcement learning applied to stock trading, asset management and banking. Assignments and projects combine a broad understanding of ML with selection of suitable methods, including unsupervised learning, for complex financial problems.

education.title: Neuroscience Specialization
education.summary: Neurophysiology, clinical neuroanatomy and the functional organization of the central nervous system. Covers neuronal excitability, synaptic transmission and plasticity; proprioception, sensory networks and motor control; neurogenesis and brain development across the lifespan; association cortices, homeostasis, memory, emotion and perception. Examines conceptual connections between human cognition, biological neural networks and intelligent software systems.

education.title: AI Agent Developer Specialization
education.summary: Hands-on AI agent development using Python, OpenAI tools and prompt engineering. Covers agent architectures, tool use, memory, custom GPTs, and responsible, trustworthy AI. Applied projects build functional agents for workflow automation, document analysis and domain-specific insights, connecting agentic design with deployment in professional scenarios. Completed AI Agents and Agentic AI with Python & Generative AI in October 2026, with a course certificate; the broader specialization remains in progress.

education.title: Boost Your Leadership Impact Specialization
education.summary: Four applied leadership projects: building trust, inclusion and effective delegation; handling difficult conversations, resolving conflict and creating a feedback-rich environment; improving presentations and professional writing; and developing networks, persuasion and influence. Builds people-management, communication and relationship practices that support team growth and performance. Completed all four courses in October 2026, with the specialization certificate issued through Coursera.

education.title: Español: A1 Specialization
education.summary: Spanish study aligned with CEFR A1.1, covering vocabulary, grammar, pronunciation and everyday communication. Topics include greetings, introductions, personal information, descriptions, locations and directions, present-tense and reflexive verbs, routines, dates, time, family and social interaction. Introduces a Chilean cultural context.

education.title: Mandarin Chinese Specialization
education.summary: Four-course program in Mandarin vocabulary, grammar, pronunciation, listening, practical communication and Chinese culture. Covers approximately 1,000 words, 75 language points and 30 everyday situations, with preparation strategies for HSK Levels 1-2. A capstone applies Mandarin in simulated real-world scenarios.

education.title: Postgraduate Degree, Neuroscience & Behavior
education.summary: Postgraduate studies in Neuroscience focused on the biological, cognitive, affective, and behavioral mechanisms underlying human brain function. The program covers functional neuroanatomy, including the prefrontal cortex, limbic system, hypothalamus, hippocampus, amygdala, and cerebellum, as well as cognition, emotion, memory, decision-making, stress regulation, and neuroplasticity. It also explores neuroimaging and brain-mapping techniques such as MRI, PET, EEG, and connectomics; neuropsychology; neuroendocrinology and the HPA axis; neurological and psychiatric disorders; attachment, childhood adversity, and human development; psychotherapy and behavioral modification; and neuromodulation techniques such as Transcranial Magnetic Stimulation (TMS).

education.title: MBA in Leadership & People Management
education.summary: MBA studies in Leadership and People Management for technology-driven organizations. Covers people leadership, self-awareness and professional development, macro trends, emerging technologies, Agile methods, digital transformation, organizational design, entrepreneurship and Industry 4.0. Develops assertive and non-violent communication, conflict resolution, feedback, 1:1s, expectation alignment, inclusive leadership, diversity, employee well-being and sustainable high performance. Further topics include personal branding, employability, innovation, new ways of working, and the roles of Product Owners, Project Managers and technical leaders in cross-functional environments.

education.title: iOS App Development with Swift Specialization
education.summary: This Specialization covers the iOS application development in the Swift programming language. It provides knowledge to use development tools such as XCode, design interfaces and interactions and evaluate their usability, and integrate camera, photo, and location information to enhance your app. In the final Capstone Project, the specialization will give the opportunity to apply your skills to create a fully-functioning photo editing app for iPhone, iPad, and Apple Watch. A Mac computer is required for success in this course.

education.title: Mathematics for Machine Learning Specialization
education.summary: Mathematical foundations for machine learning, connecting linear algebra, multivariate calculus and principal component analysis with practical applications. Covers vectors and matrices, model fitting and optimization, and dimensionality reduction through PCA. Applied exercises use Python and NumPy to connect mathematical reasoning with implementation.

education.title: Postgraduate Degree, Quantum Computing
education.summary: Postgraduate studies in quantum computing, connecting quantum mechanics, information theory and mathematical foundations with practical quantum programming. Covers qubits, superposition, entanglement, interference, quantum gates and teleportation; Deutsch-Jozsa, Bernstein-Vazirani and Simon algorithms; the Quantum Fourier Transform; and Shor and Grover algorithms. Hands-on work uses Python and Qiskit, Q#, the Microsoft Quantum Development Kit, Azure Quantum, IBM Quantum, simulators and real quantum hardware. Explores quantum machine learning and AI, cryptography and the implications for RSA, NISQ systems, and applications in finance, optimization and materials science.
